title: Strengths and weaknesses
intro: Name one real strength with an example, and one weakness you're actively improving.
introNative: एक असली strength example के साथ बताइए, और एक weakness भी, जिसे आप अभी सुधार रहे हैं।

phrases.text: One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.
phrases.native: Production issues को जल्दी debug करना मेरी strengths में से एक है।
phrases.note: Pick a specific strength, not "hard worker".

phrases.text: For example, last quarter I fixed a critical payment bug within two hours.
phrases.native: जैसे, पिछले quarter में मैंने एक critical payment bug दो घंटे के अंदर fix किया।
phrases.note: An example makes a strength believable.

phrases.text: Something I'm working on is presenting to senior stakeholders.
phrases.native: एक चीज़ जिस पर मैं अभी काम कर रहा हूँ, वह है senior stakeholders के सामने present करना।
phrases.note: Choose a real weakness that won't stop you doing the job.

phrases.text: To improve, I now volunteer to present our sprint demos.
phrases.native: इसे सुधारने के लिए, अब मैं खुद आगे बढ़कर हमारे sprint demos present करता हूँ।
phrases.note: Always show the action you're taking to improve.

phrases.text: My colleagues often come to me when they're stuck on a tricky bug.
phrases.native: जब मेरे colleagues किसी tricky bug में अटक जाते हैं, तो वे अक्सर मेरे पास आते हैं।
phrases.note: What others rely on you for sounds more natural than self-praise.

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks: "What are your strengths?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: Interviewer पूछते हैं: "आपकी strengths क्या हैं?" कौन सा जवाब सबसे अच्छा है?
options: I am a hard worker and quick learner.
One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.
I am good in all the things, no weakness.
steps.answer: One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.
steps.explanation: A specific, job-related strength sounds genuine; general words sound memorised.
steps.explanationNative: काम से जुड़ी एक specific strength genuine लगती है; general शब्द रटे हुए लगते हैं।

steps.promptNative: एक चीज़ जिस पर मैं अभी काम कर रहा हूँ, वह है senior stakeholders के सामने present करना।
steps.answer: Something I'm working on is presenting to senior stakeholders.

steps.audioText: For example, last quarter I fixed a critical payment bug within two hours.
options: For example, last quarter I fixed a critical payment bug within two days.
For example, last quarter I found a critical payment bug within two hours.
For example, last quarter I fixed a critical payment bug within two hours.
steps.answer: For example, last quarter I fixed a critical payment bug within two hours.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I am a hard worker and quick learner only.
options: I am a hard worker and quick learner only.
I'm a quick learner; I picked up Kubernetes in two weeks.
I am hard worker and quick learner.
I am a hard worker and quick learner, that's all.
steps.answer: I'm a quick learner; I picked up Kubernetes in two weeks.
steps.explanation: Drop the "only", and back up a strength with a real example instead of a list of adjectives.
steps.explanationNative: "Only" हटा दीजिए, और adjectives की list के बजाय एक असली example से अपनी strength साबित कीजिए।

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks: "What is your weakness?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: Interviewer पूछते हैं: "आपकी weakness क्या है?" कौन सा जवाब सबसे अच्छा है?
options: I don't have any weakness.
Something I'm working on is presenting to senior stakeholders.
My weakness is I work too hard.
steps.answer: Something I'm working on is presenting to senior stakeholders.
steps.explanation: Name a real, fixable weakness; "no weakness" or "I work too hard" sounds rehearsed.
steps.explanationNative: एक असली weakness बताइए जिसे सुधारा जा सके; "no weakness" या "I work too hard" रटा हुआ लगता है।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: My weakness is I can't able to say no.
options: My weakness is I can't able to say no.
My weakness is that I find it hard to say no.
My weakness is I am not able to say no only.
My weakness is I could not able to say no.
steps.answer: My weakness is that I find it hard to say no.
steps.explanation: Never say "can't able to"; use "can't", "I'm not able to", or more naturally "I find it hard to".
steps.explanationNative: "Can't able to" कभी मत कहिए; "can't", "I'm not able to", या ज़्यादा natural तरीके से "I find it hard to" कहिए।

steps.promptNative: इसे सुधारने के लिए, अब मैं खुद आगे बढ़कर हमारे sprint demos present करता हूँ।
steps.answer: To improve, I now volunteer to present our sprint demos.

steps.audioText: One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.
options: One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.
One of my strengths is fixing production issues quickly.
One of my strengths is debugging product issues carefully.
steps.answer: One of my strengths is debugging production issues quickly.

steps.prompt: Answer "What are your strengths and weaknesses?" out loud in 4 sentences about yourself: one real strength with an example, and one weakness with what you're doing to improve it.
steps.promptNative: "आपकी strengths और weaknesses क्या हैं?" का जवाब अपने बारे में 4 sentences में बोलकर दीजिए: example के साथ एक असली strength, और एक weakness, साथ में यह कि उसे सुधारने के लिए आप क्या कर रहे हैं।
